newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel up, other base metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel up, other base metals steady.

text.p: Indian nickel prices rose sharply on speculative buying while other base metals were steady on Tuesday, dealers said.
Nickel jumped up 200 rupees to 37,400 rupees per quintal on heavy speculative buying following reports of a price rise in world markets, dealers said.
"Nickel prices in the world market have gone up to their highest in eight months on limited supplies from Russia," one dealer said.
Copper was steady at 12,800 rupees per quintal in thin trade, dealers said. It was down 50 rupees on Monday and 150 rupees last week.
Zinc prices were steady at 7,300 rupees per quintal on limited arrivals. Zinc was up 100 rupees on Monday and 250 rupees last week.
Other metals were unchanged in quiet trade with lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal, aluminium at 7,250 rupees and tin at 34,100 rupees per quintal, dealers said.
Traders said they expected dull trade in the days ahead of presentation of the federal budget on Friday.
